soundness: Every entry is a slot "an edge avoiding this 4-set of named points": exists in every counterexample by tau>=5, so adding any of them is sound regardless of this ranking. The ranking is heuristic.
ranking_metric: rigidity_nsig = number of region signatures (counts per region v,w,alpha,gamma,m3,a3,a4,c3,c4 + o-vector) of avoider states feasible against the base under all one-new-edge lemmas (w13_enum.check; o_i<=L_i+2). Lower = more forced. Computed over all 145 symmetry orbits of base-transversal core 4-sets (group order 576), w13_rigid.json.
caveat: No 4-set is provably forced-hit by the first-generation singles at the one- or two-edge level (S13.3); the list is principled by symmetry + local rigidity, not by a joint proof.

candidates.tier: A1 (G-invariant; most rigid of all 145 base-transversal orbits)
candidates.why: B = T012∪T013∪T023 = every point of P0 lying in a triple intersection. Lemma JA (S13.4): the avoider J has |J∩γ|≥2+o0+o1, a3,a4,m3 each hit, and Σ|J∩P_i|∈{20,21}: J meets ≥3 base edges in exactly 5 (all four in 72/109 local states), i.e. J is a FIFTH vertex of a clique of 5-pairs and spawns new K4s {P0,P1,P2,J} (triples 1,m',a3',g'+c3'), {P0,P1,P3,J}, {P0,P2,P3,J}. In 106/109 local states J is itself a first-gen single of (0,1)/(0,2)/(0,3) in a RARE shape (e.g. a (0,1)-single with A-part a3∪a4: one region signature), so it forces a single type into an extreme state. In the 10-single realization M10 (and w12m1) EVERY edge contains {v,w} or α (min transversals {v|w}×{al0|al1}); J_A is exactly the edge that breaks this. Tried ONLY in chain B (7 γ-singles, no m3-singles), where it was REALIZED (w10x_w12b1/Br1/Br2_real.json contain J1) — so it is not a killer by itself; never tried together with the m3-singles (chains M/N/P).
